observations.result_summary: The first-party PR #615 verification reports a live Marveen test installation where the services-up identity-save path changed durable brand, owner and CLAUDE.md persona state while leaving internal routing/service identifiers and tmux session names unchanged; the old persona token had zero remaining CLAUDE.md occurrences, and the test installation was restored afterwards.

That follow-up is provenance/mechanism support only here and is not counted as a second observation/result.
observations.notes: This record is function-neutral. It does not claim that the shipped self-rename skill itself executed the PR #615 live test, does not treat Claude Code /rename or internal MAIN_AGENT_ID/SERVICE_ID changes as part of this observation, and does not claim a later model turn loaded or behaviorally followed the changed persona.
